description: Imports Gong revenue-intelligence data: calls, users, scorecard reviews, and scorecard definitions.

placeholders.region: user-supplied `region` endpoint config field (e.g. 'us-55616'); found in the customer's Gong API settings

spec.apiVersionPinning: path segment `/v2` embedded in every stream URL_PATH

credentialModes.name: API key (Access Key + Access Key Secret)

configFields.name: credentials.access_key_secret
configFields.description: The Gong API Access Key Secret.

configFields.name: region
configFields.description: API region subdomain for the Gong account; defaults to 'us-55616'.

configFields.name: start_date
configFields.description: UTC datetime; data before this is not replicated. Defaults to 30 days ago.

configFields.name: calls_lookback_window
configFields.description: 1-30, default 7. Days to look back once per day when fetching calls, to capture post-call enrichment.

configFields.name: interval
configFields.description: ISO-8601 duration between updates for this resource.

configFields.name: schedule
configFields.description: Cron expression to automatically re-backfill this binding.

params.fromDateTime: <cursor timestamp, minus calls_lookback_window days on the first run of each day>

authTierRationale: Exactly one credential mode: a Gong Access Key + Access Key Secret pair the user self-serves from Gong's API settings, sent as HTTP Basic (base64 of 'access_key:access_key_secret') in the Authorization header by the CDK's TokenSource. The connector explicitly constructs TokenSource with oauth_spec=None, so no OAuth app registration and no refresh token are involved.

unionMisfits.description: For the POST streams the date filter is not a flat param map: it is nested under a `filter` object in the JSON request body (FILTER_WRAPPER), while the pagination `cursor` sits at the TOP level of that same body, as a sibling of `filter`. The schema's flat `params` map plus `incrementalParam.param` cannot express 'the incremental bound is nested one level but the page token is not'.

Two distinct incremental behaviours share one shape. `calls` uses a daily-triggered lookback re-read (re-emits up to calls_lookback_window days of already-seen calls on the first run of each calendar day, deduped downstream by primary key), while `users`/`scorecards` walk forward in fixed 1-day windows and emit max(cursor)+1s. There is no field for 'lookback/overlap window' or 'window step size'.

Gong returns HTTP 404 with a body like {"errors":["No calls found corresponding to the provided filters"]} instead of a 200 with an empty array when a filtered query matches zero rows; the connector regex-matches that body and treats it as an empty page, re-raising any other 404. There is nowhere in the schema to record 'empty result is signalled by an error status'.

The connector ships a client-side sliding-window rate limiter (170 requests per 60 seconds, described in code as a safety margin under Gong's ~3 req/s limit) applied to every request including credential validation. The schema has no rate-limit field.

The `users` cron '0 0 * * *' is not a second poll cadence — in this CDK the resource-config `schedule` field triggers an automatic RE-BACKFILL of the binding (the description reads 'Schedule to automatically rebackfill this binding'). `role` is free text, so this is representable but easy to misread as a poll schedule.

streams[1].pull.backfill.path.snippet:
URL_PATH = "/v2/users/extensive"
    METHOD = HttpMethod.POST
    FROM_PARAM = "createdFromDateTime"
    FILTER_WRAPPER = True

streams[1].schedules.snippet:
schedule = "0 0 * * *" if cls is User else None
        config_kwargs = {"name": cls.NAME, "interval": timedelta(minutes=2)}

streams[2].pull.backfill.path.snippet:
URL_PATH = "/v2/stats/activity/scorecards"
    METHOD = HttpMethod.POST
    DATE_FORMAT = DateFormat.DATE
    FROM_PARAM = "reviewFromDate"

execution.mode.snippet:
async def fetch_changes(...):
    start_date = _ts_to_dt(log_cursor)
    end_date = min(start_date + timedelta(days=1), now)

abstained.transports[0].spec.defaultHeaders: No connector-level default headers are set; the Authorization header is added by the shared CDK HTTP session from TokenSource, and no other static headers appear.
abstained.execution.defaultSchedule: There is no connector-wide default; every binding carries its own interval (and users additionally a cron) in its initial ResourceConfigWithSchedule.
abstained.execution.continuity: mode is 'poll' over a stateless REST API; no server-side artifacts are created and the schema makes continuity optional for poll mode. Gong-side retention of calls/scorecards is not described anywhere in the connector source, so no resumeWindow can be asserted.
abstained.streams[].pull.*.paginator.pageSize: No page-size parameter is ever sent; the connector accepts Gong's server-side default page size. records.currentPageSize is parsed but never used to control paging.
abstained.streams[].pull.*.paginator.hasMorePath: Termination is purely on the absence of records.cursor; the envelope exposes totalRecords/currentPageNumber but the code never reads them.
abstained.streams[3].cursorField: scorecard_definitions is a full-refresh snapshot resource with a synthetic row_id key; the model declares no CURSOR_FIELD.
abstained.discovery: streamMode is static — the four bindings are hard-coded model classes, confirmed by the discover snapshot. No discovery mechanism exists.
abstained.streams[].pull.*.recordsPath: Recorded as the ITEMS_KEY the envelope pops from the response object (e.g. 'calls', 'users', 'scorecards'); note scorecards and scorecard_definitions BOTH use items key 'scorecards' at different paths, which is intentional in the source but worth verifying against live responses.
